questions.prompt: What color is Lily's new schoolbag?

questions.prompt: How many storybooks are in Lily's schoolbag?

questions.explanation: 短文最后一句提到Ben有一支绿色的钢笔（a green pen），故选A。

title: 三年级英语语法完形一：温馨的周末早晨

questions.evidence: My family (1) ____ at home in the morning.

questions.explanation: 空白前有基数词two（两个），后面应接可数名词的复数形式apples，故选B。

title: 放学后的音乐社团
